nodes.name: Search Media Library
nodes.notes: No credential attached on import. Create an HTTP Basic Auth credential with your ImageKit private key as the username and an empty password, then select it here. See README > First login setup.

nodes.name: Expand assets x variants
nodes.notes: Fans out N assets x M variants into N*M jobs, capped by maxAssets (default 200, same default as imagekit-render-creative-automation's MAX_FAN_OUT) so a bad searchQuery cannot fan out to thousands of jobs.

nodes.name: Build Transformation URL
nodes.notes: Public DevTools MCP, no auth required. Calls the transformation_builder tool directly as a normal workflow step (not as an AI Agent tool) -- this is the standalone MCP Client node, distinct from the MCP Client Tool sub-node used in imagekit-library-chat.json.
